end.summary:
Discussed festivals across India and their links with seasons and harvests.
Kavya identified Pongal as a January festival.
Kavya repeated that April is linked with wheat harvest after Asha’s explanation.
Kavya continued to mix up festival timing and seasons; teach-back was not passed.
The lesson ended when Kavya said they were tired.
end.parentNote: Asha practised connecting festivals with months, seasons, and harvests. Kavya repeated the April wheat-harvest example after it was explained, but continued to say that festivals can happen in any season. At home, use a simple month-and-festival calendar and ask Kavya to match one festival with its season or harvest at a time.
